integrity: The recurrence and every root bracket are replayed with exact integer/rational arithmetic; no numerical root approximation is used by the verifier.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-range result for 1<=n<=50 only; no claim for n>50 and no asymptotic theorem.
title: Exact real-rootedness through \(n=50\) for the even Poincaré polynomials of \(\overline{\mathcal M}_{1,n}\)
